source: No email app found to send feedback
text: Nta imeri porogaramu byabonetse kuri oherereza igisubizo

source: Could not use picture: camera file
Offline — no known stations in range. Enter place manually.
text: Nta murandasi — oya bizwi stations muri interi. Injiza ahantu manually.

source: The database couldn't be opened or upgraded from schema %1$s to %2$s;
text: ububiko bw'amakuru couldn't ba opened cyangwa upgraded kuva schema %1$s kuri %2$s;

source: This permanently deletes all vehicles, fuel and expense records on this device.
text: Iki burundu deletes byose imodoka, lisansi na igiciro records kuri iki igikoresho.

source: Export first with: %1$s. This cannot be undone.
text: Kohereza ya mbere na: %1$s. Iki ntishobora ba undone.

source: stale transfer staging couldn't be removed
text: stale transfer staging couldn't ba removed

source: Tap the currency symbol on amount to change currency.
text: Kanda ifaranga symbol kuri amount kuri hindura ifaranga.

source: Time is now (default on create) stamps the save time; uncheck to pick date/time.
text: Igihe ni ubu (isanzwe kuri kora) stamps bika igihe; uncheck kuri hitamo itariki/igihe.

source: Manage categories… stays pinned at the bottom of the category menu
text: Cunga ibyiciro… stays pinned kuri bottom ya icyiciro menu

source: (scroll the list above if long; select a vehicle first).
text: (scroll urutonde above niba rire; hitamo imodoka ya mbere).
Nta murandasi — ahantu lookup igihe kuri murandasi

source: No place found (will retry after save if online)
text: Nta ahantu byabonetse (azakora ongera ugerageze nyuma bika niba kuri murandasi)

source: Receipt is in cloud backup only
text: Inyemezabwishyu ni muri igicu ububiko gusa

source: Tap a card to edit. Add from Menu → New expense, or Reports hub.
text: Kanda ikarita kuri hindura. Ongeraho kuva Menu → Nshya igiciro, cyangwa Raporo hub.

source: First item is the new-expense default. Renames/deletes do not rewrite past expense Category strings.
text: Ya mbere ikintu ni nshya-igiciro isanzwe. Renames/deletes kora ntabwo rewrite past igiciro Icyiciro strings.

source: Dash captured. Enter odometer if needed, or switch to pump.
text: Dashibodi captured. Injiza odometer niba bikenewe, cyangwa hindura kuri pompe.

source: Pump photo captured. Enter cost/volume if needed, then Save.
text: Pompe ifoto captured. Injiza igiciro/ingano niba bikenewe, hanyuma Bika.
Nta murandasi — oya bizwi sitasiyo nearby

source: Aim at odometer. Tap shutter to capture.
text: Aim kuri odometer. Kanda shuteri kuri fata.

source: White circle — shutter (capture dash or pump).
text: White circle — shuteri (fata dashibodi cyangwa pompe).

source: Disk — save the fill when fields are ready.
text: Disk — bika kuzuza igihe imyanya ni biteguye.

source: Type odo/cost/volume anytime (custom keypad). Menu → Help for the full walkthrough.
text: Ubwoko odo/igiciro/ingano anytime (bwihariye keypad). Menu → Ubufasha kuri full walkthrough.

source: Error: Image buffer is not direct
text: Ikosa: Ishusho buffer ni ntabwo direct

source: Photo save failed — entry will have no photo
text: Ifoto bika byanze — entry azakora ufite oya ifoto

source: Could not save fuel photo to gallery: %1$s
text: Ntibishoboka bika lisansi ifoto kuri galeri: %1$s

source: Aim at pump display (cost/volume). Tap shutter to capture.
text: Aim kuri pompe erekana (igiciro/ingano). Kanda shuteri kuri fata.

source: Per-vehicle tabs list fuel fills only (trip starts are under Reports → Trip miles).
text: Buri-imodoka tabs urutonde lisansi kuzuza gusa (urugendo itangira ni munsi Raporo → Urugendo amayili).

source: Tap a row to edit. Missing photos can be fetched from archive when cloud identity exists.
text: Kanda umurongo kuri hindura. Bibuze amafoto ashobora ba fetched kuva ububiko igihe igicu identity exists.

source: Per-vehicle fills (no trip starts). Tap a card to edit. Thumbnails fetch from archive when missing locally.
text: Buri-imodoka kuzuza (oya urugendo itangira). Kanda ikarita kuri hindura. Thumbnails zana kuva ububiko igihe bibuze locally.

source: No fuel entries for this vehicle
text: Nta lisansi entries kuri iki imodoka

source: Short on-device guide so you can start immediately. For screenshots and every step, open the full illustrated manual (bundled in the app — works offline, no GitHub login).
text: Short kuri-igikoresho guide bityo wowe ashobora tangira immediately. Kuri screenshots na buri intambwe, fungura full illustrated n'intoki (bundled muri porogaramu — works nta murandasi, oya GitHub login).

source: Short step-by-step walkthroughs with screenshots (offline). Also offered on first run when you have no vehicles.
text: Short intambwe-na-intambwe walkthroughs na screenshots (nta murandasi). Kandi offered kuri ya mbere koresha igihe wowe ufite oya imodoka.

source: Connect existing setup = join another device’s shared sheet + photo folder (not create a new blank sheet).
text: Huza existing gushyiraho = join indi igikoresho’s shared urupapuro + ifoto dosiye (ntabwo kora nshya ubusa urupapuro).
Erekana ya mbere-koresha murakaza neza choices

source: ⓘ (title bar) — page help for the current screen (stays while you stay on the page)
text: ⓘ (umutwe bar) — urupapuro ubufasha kuri current ekara (stays while wowe stay kuri urupapuro)

source: ! (red, title bar) — last spreadsheet or photo sync failed; opens Syncing
text: ! (red, umutwe bar) — ya nyuma urupapuro rw'imibare cyangwa ifoto guhuza byanze; opens Birimo guhuza

source: ?N (title bar) — open Import / Review questions when items need answers
text: ?N (umutwe bar) — fungura Kuzana / Suzuma ibibazo igihe items need answers

source: White circle — shutter (capture dash, pump, or receipt)
text: White circle — shuteri (fata dashibodi, pompe, cyangwa inyemezabwishyu)

source: ↕ on Fill — switch odometer mode ↔ pump (cost/volume) mode
text: ↕ kuri Kuzuza — hindura odometer uburyo ↔ pompe (igiciro/ingano) uburyo

source: ↔ between cost and volume — swap the two values if OCR swapped them
text: ↔ between igiciro na ingano — swap two values niba OCR swapped them

source: 🔍 on sync forms — browse Google Drive for a sheet or folder
text: 🔍 kuri guhuza forms — shakisha Google Drive kuri urupapuro cyangwa dosiye

source: Menu → Manage Vehicles → Vehicle dropdown → Add New Vehicle
text: Menu → Cunga Imodoka → Imodoka dropdown → Ongeraho Nshya Imodoka

source: Take or pick a clear dashboard photo
text: Take cyangwa hitamo siba dashboard ifoto

source: Run Discovery, Select Odo, tap the seed, adjust, Save
text: Koresha Discovery, Hitamo Odo, kanda seed, adjust, Bika

source: Run Discovery, review landmarks (Edit OCR to fix misses), enter a Vehicle Name
text: Koresha Discovery, suzuma landmarks (Hindura OCR kuri kosora misses), injiza Imodoka Izina

source: Landmarks power auto vehicle match on Fill. No camera? Type odo/volume/cost by hand.
text: Landmarks power byikora imodoka hura kuri Kuzuza. Oya kamera? Ubwoko odo/ingano/igiciro na hand.

source: Open the app (Fill is home) — no need to pick the vehicle first
text: Fungura porogaramu (Kuzuza ni home) — oya need kuri hitamo imodoka ya mbere

source: Aim at the odometer → shutter → confirm Odo (vehicle auto-detects from landmarks)
text: Aim kuri odometer → shuteri → emeza Odo (imodoka byikora-detects kuva landmarks)

source: Tap ↕ for pump mode → aim at pump totals → shutter
text: Kanda ↕ kuri pompe uburyo → aim kuri pompe totals → shuteri

source: Fix fields if needed (tap currency or G/L to change units)
text: Kosora imyanya niba bikenewe (kanda ifaranga cyangwa G/L kuri hindura units)

source: Disk (Save). Blank fields are allowed as a partial fill. Works offline
text: Disk (Bika). Ubusa imyanya ni allowed nk' partial kuzuza. Works nta murandasi

source: Shutter or gallery for the receipt; fill vendor, amount, category, vehicle
text: Shuteri cyangwa galeri kuri inyemezabwishyu; kuzuza umucuruzi, amount, icyiciro, imodoka

source: Save. Open expenses from Reports → Expenses list to review or edit later
text: Bika. Fungura ibiciro kuva Raporo → Ibiciro urutonde kuri suzuma cyangwa hindura nyuma

source: Menu → Reports — hub summary, then report cards
text: Menu → Raporo — hub summary, hanyuma raporo cards

source: Time based reports — one plot with independent Y scales (mpg and G/mi on the left; $ / trip miles / trip %% by type on the right),
text: Igihe based raporo — imwe plot na independent Y scales (mpg na G/mi kuri ibumoso; $ / urugendo amayili / urugendo %% na ubwoko kuri iburyo),

source: Fill history lists fills only; Trip miles has the trip-start list (tap a row to edit)
text: Kuzuza amateka lists kuzuza gusa; Urugendo amayili afite urugendo-tangira urutonde (kanda umurongo kuri hindura)

source: Fuel History and edit screens can Fetch image from archive when any photo destination has the file
text: Lisansi Amateka na hindura screens ashobora Zana ishusho kuva ububiko igihe any ifoto ahageze afite dosiye

source: Use your own accounts — not a shared app cloud. Sync is background; no network needed to add fills.
text: Koresha cyawe own konti — ntabwo shared porogaramu igicu. Guhuza ni inyuma; oya urusobe bikenewe kuri ongeraho kuzuza.

source: Settings → Spreadsheet sync: Google Sheets, Excel, EtherCalc, or Other (Baserow, NocoDB, Airtable, PocketBase, Supabase, Firebase, Zoho Sheet, …)
text: Igenamiterere → Urupapuro rw'imibare guhuza: Google Impapuro, Excel, EtherCalc, cyangwa Indi (Baserow, NocoDB, Airtable, PocketBase, Supabase, Firebase, Zoho Urupapuro, …)

source: Settings → Photo backup: Google Drive, OneDrive, S3, or Other (WebDAV/SFTP/… via rclone)
text: Igenamiterere → Ifoto ububiko: Google Drive, OneDrive, S3, cyangwa Indi (WebDAV/SFTP/… via rclone)

source: Full provider list and setup: online manual or self-host index.
text: Full provider urutonde na gushyiraho: kuri murandasi n'intoki cyangwa self-host index.

source: Red error under Spreadsheet sync / Photo backup in Settings
text: Red ikosa munsi Urupapuro rw'imibare guhuza / Ifoto ububiko muri Igenamiterere

source: Red ! in the title bar → Settings
Yellow ? in the title bar → Import / Review questions
text: Yellow? muri umutwe bar → Kuzana / Suzuma ibibazo

source: Same fill entered twice on two devices = two rows; delete the extra
text: Kimwe kuzuza entered twice kuri two devices = two imirongo; siba inyongera

source: Import Old Pictures and experiment screens are advanced tools and are not covered here.
text: Kuzana Bushaje Amashusho na experiment screens ni byateye imbere tools na ni ntabwo covered here.

source: Batch import references your existing dash/pump photo files in place (does not copy them).
text: Batch kuzana references cyawe existing dashibodi/pompe ifoto dosiye muri ahantu (does ntabwo kopiya them).

source: No vehicles yet. Choose stand-alone (add a vehicle on this phone) or connect to an existing multi-device setup (same sheet + photo folder).
text: Nta imodoka n'ubu. Hitamo stand-alone (ongeraho imodoka kuri iki telefone) cyangwa huza kuri existing multi-igikoresho gushyiraho (kimwe urupapuro + ifoto dosiye).

source: You can skip and use Fill manually; this screen returns on the next start until a vehicle exists.
text: Ushobora gusimbuka no gukoresha kuzuza n'intoki; iki ekara kigaruka ku ntangiriro ikurikira kugeza imodoka ibaho.

source: You don’t have a vehicle yet. How do you want to start?
text: Wowe don’t ufite imodoka n'ubu. How kora wowe want kuri tangira?

source: This phone is stand-alone / first vehicle
text: Iki telefone ni stand-alone / ya mbere imodoka

source: Another device already has the app — join that sheet + photo folder
text: Indi igikoresho yamaze afite porogaramu — join icyo urupapuro + ifoto dosiye

source: You can enter fills by hand. This welcome screen returns next launch until you add a vehicle.
text: Wowe ashobora injiza kuzuza na hand. Iki murakaza neza ekara returns ikurikira launch until wowe ongeraho imodoka.

source: From the menu (☰), choose Manage Vehicles. This is where you create dashboards
text: Kuva menu (☰), hitamo Cunga Imodoka. Iki ni where wowe kora dashboards

source: Open the vehicle dropdown and pick Add New Vehicle. You are setting up this phone
text: Fungura imodoka dropdown na hitamo Ongeraho Nshya Imodoka. Wowe ni setting hejuru iki telefone

source: as stand-alone / first vehicle (or an additional vehicle).
text: nk' stand-alone / ya mbere imodoka (cyangwa additional imodoka).

source: Take or pick a clear photo of the instrument cluster. Good lighting and a square-on
text: Take cyangwa hitamo siba ifoto ya instrument cluster. Good lighting na square-kuri

source: view of the odometer help discovery.
Run Discovery, Select Odo, tap the seed, adjust, Save.
text: Koresha Discovery, Hitamo Odo, kanda seed, adjust, Bika.

source: Review landmarks. Edit OCR text if something was missed.
text: Suzuma landmarks. Hindura OCR text niba something yari missed.

source: Enter a Vehicle Name, then Create Vehicle. After at least one user vehicle exists,
text: Injiza Imodoka Izina, hanyuma Kora Imodoka. Nyuma kuri least imwe ukoresha imodoka exists,

source: the first-run splash will not appear again.
text: ya mbere-koresha splash azakora ntabwo appear nanone.

source: This path is for a **new phone or tablet** joining an **existing** Vehicle Expenses setup.
text: Iki inzira ni kuri **nshya telefone cyangwa tablet** joining **existing** Imodoka Ibiciro gushyiraho.

source: Another device already has vehicles, a **shared spreadsheet**, and usually a **shared photo folder**.
text: Indi igikoresho yamaze afite imodoka, **shared urupapuro rw'imibare**, na usually **shared ifoto dosiye**.

source: You use **your** Google / Microsoft / other account — not an app-hosted cloud.
text: Wowe koresha **cyawe** Google / Microsoft / indi konti — ntabwo porogaramu-hosted igicu.

source: Stand-alone first setup (no other device yet) is **Add a vehicle**, not this tutorial.
text: Stand-alone ya mbere gushyiraho (oya indi igikoresho n'ubu) ni **Ongeraho imodoka**, ntabwo iki tutorial.
Fungura Birimo guhuza kuri iki igikoresho

source: From the menu (☰), open **Syncing**. You will add destinations that point at the **same**
text: Kuva menu (☰), fungura **Birimo guhuza**. Wowe azakora ongeraho aho hageze icyo point kuri **kimwe**

source: sheet and photo folder the other device already uses — not brand-new empty ones.
text: urupapuro na ifoto dosiye indi igikoresho yamaze uses — ntabwo brand-nshya ubusa ones.

source: Spreadsheet: open the existing shared file
text: Urupapuro rw'imibare: fungura existing shared dosiye

source: Add a spreadsheet destination → pick the same provider as the other device (often Google Sheets) →
text: Ongeraho urupapuro rw'imibare ahageze → hitamo kimwe provider nk' indi igikoresho (often Google Impapuro) →

source: sign in. Paste the **existing sheet URL** from the other phone (or Drive **browse to that file**).
text: injira. Omeka **existing urupapuro URL** kuva indi telefone (cyangwa Drive **shakisha kuri icyo dosiye**).

source: Test connection, then **Sync now** to pull vehicles and rows.
text: Igerageza connection, hanyuma **Guhuza ubu** kuri pull imodoka na imirongo.

source: **Do not Create** a new blank spreadsheet for this path (if the UI still offers Create, skip it).
text: **Kora ntabwo Kora** nshya ubusa urupapuro rw'imibare kuri iki inzira (niba UI still offers Kora, simbuka yo).

source: Add a photo destination → same provider as the other device → sign in.
text: Ongeraho ifoto ahageze → kimwe provider nk' indi igikoresho → injira.

source: Choose the **same photo folder** already used by the cluster (URL or browse).
text: Hitamo **kimwe ifoto dosiye** yamaze used na cluster (URL cyangwa shakisha).

source: Test connection → Sync now. Vehicle reference images can download automatically;
text: Igerageza connection → Guhuza ubu. Imodoka indango images ashobora download automatically;

source: fill/receipt photos are on-demand via Fetch from archive.
text: kuzuza/inyemezabwishyu amafoto ni kuri-demand via Zana kuva ububiko.

source: **Do not create a new empty folder** for this path.
text: **Kora ntabwo kora nshya ubusa dosiye** kuri iki inzira.

source: Vehicles and data should appear from the shared sheet. Only then, if a vehicle is missing
text: Imodoka na amakuru should appear kuva shared urupapuro. Gusa hanyuma, niba imodoka ni bibuze

source: a local dash photo, open Manage Vehicles and capture or fetch the reference image.
text: bw'ahantu dashibodi ifoto, fungura Cunga Imodoka na fata cyangwa zana indango ishusho.

source: You do not need to re-type the whole fleet from scratch.
text: Wowe kora ntabwo need kuri re-ubwoko whole fleet kuva scratch.

source: Keep local and leave the sheet
Keep local and write it back
text: Bika bw'ahantu na write yo inyuma

source: Create Firestore collections with string fields matching app headers (Sync ID first).
text: Kora Firestore collections na string imyanya matching porogaramu headers (Guhuza IKIRANGA ya mbere).

source: Use a short-lived ID token or power-user access token — never ship unrestricted service accounts in the APK.
text: Koresha short-lived IKIRANGA token cyangwa power-ukoresha kwinjira token — ntabwo na rimwe ship unrestricted service konti muri APK.

source: No items visible. With Drive access limited to this app, open or create files here first.
text: Nta items bigaragara. Na Drive kwinjira limited kuri iki porogaramu, fungura cyangwa kora dosiye here ya mbere.

source: No spreadsheets found. Try search, or paste a sheet URL if it is shared with your account.
text: Nta impapuro z'imibare byabonetse. Gerageza shakisha, cyangwa omeka urupapuro URL niba yo ni shared na cyawe konti.

source: No folders found. Try search, or paste a folder URL if it is shared with your account.
text: Nta dosiye byabonetse. Gerageza shakisha, cyangwa omeka dosiye URL niba yo ni shared na cyawe konti.

source: %1$s created or opened in this app.
text: %1$s created cyangwa opened muri iki porogaramu.

source: All %1$s your Google account can view, including shared files.
text: Byose %1$s cyawe Google konti ashobora reba, including shared dosiye.

source: Allow Drive read access to list all %1$s (owned and shared with you).
text: Emerera Drive soma kwinjira kuri urutonde byose %1$s (owned na shared na wowe).

source: Sign-in failed — try again or pick a Google account with Drive access
text: Injira-muri byanze — gerageza nanone cyangwa hitamo Google konti na Drive kwinjira

source: Drive browse access not granted — try again
text: Drive shakisha kwinjira ntabwo granted — gerageza nanone

source: Paste a link or use browse
No folders visible. Create one here or open an existing folder in this app first.
text: Nta dosiye bigaragara. Kora imwe here cyangwa fungura existing dosiye muri iki porogaramu ya mbere.

source: S3 and compatible services (Wasabi, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, …).
text: S3 na compatible services (Wasabi, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, …).

source: Required for MinIO and custom S3-compatible hosts
text: Bisabwa kuri MinIO na bwihariye S3-compatible hosts

source: Photos upload under this path on your signed-in OneDrive.
text: Amafoto upload munsi iki inzira kuri cyawe winjiye-muri OneDrive.

source: Create a remote on this device or pick one from the conf. Powered by rclone for WebDAV, SFTP, Azure, and more.
text: Kora kure kuri iki igikoresho cyangwa hitamo imwe kuva conf. Powered na rclone kuri WebDAV, SFTP, Azure, na byinshi.

source: Enter access key and secret, or save S3 credentials first
text: Injiza kwinjira urufunguzo na secret, cyangwa bika S3 credentials ya mbere

source: Create or select a remote first
text: Kora cyangwa hitamo kure ya mbere

source: Add Google Drive (or other) destinations. Sync now uploads vehicle refs and pending photos.
text: Ongeraho Google Drive (cyangwa indi) aho hageze. Guhuza ubu uploads imodoka refs na bitegereje amafoto.

source: Open a destination for Test connection and Sync now (this destination).
text: Fungura ahageze kuri Igerageza connection na Guhuza ubu (iki ahageze).

source: Leaving the screen mid-sync does not cancel the backup.
text: Leaving ekara mid-guhuza does ntabwo hagarika ububiko.

source: Add a destination (Google Drive is common: Sign in with Google (Drive) → optional folder via 🔍 → save → Sync now). Manual sync runs all configured destinations; background backup runs enabled ones only.
text: Ongeraho ahageze (Google Drive ni common: INJIRA na Google (Drive) → optional dosiye via 🔍 → bika → Guhuza ubu). N'intoki guhuza runs byose configured aho hageze; inyuma ububiko runs byemejwe ones gusa.

source: No remotes in this conf yet. Create one with +.
text: Nta remotes muri iki conf n'ubu. Kora imwe na +.

source: Could not open browser for sign-in
Requires browser sign-in. Complete authorization in the browser, then continue.
text: Requires mucukumbuzi injira-muri. Byuzuye authorization muri mucukumbuzi, hanyuma komeza.

source: Choose a category, then pick a backend. Import conf on the destination screen for advanced setups.
text: Hitamo icyiciro, hanyuma hitamo backend. Kuzana conf kuri ahageze ekara kuri byateye imbere setups.

source: No backends in this category. Try another kind or import rclone.conf.
text: Nta backends muri iki icyiciro. Gerageza indi kind cyangwa kuzana rclone.conf.

source: This backend needs browser OAuth. You can try guided sign-in below,
text: Iki backend needs mucukumbuzi OAuth. Wowe ashobora gerageza guided injira-muri below,

source: or use Import existing conf… for a desktop-built remote.
text: cyangwa koresha Kuzana existing conf… kuri desktop-built kure.

source: No extra fields for %1$s. Save to add the remote.
text: Nta inyongera imyanya kuri %1$s. Bika kuri ongeraho kure.

source: Create tables/collections with fields matching app headers (Sync ID first). Map table ids below.
text: Kora tables/collections na imyanya matching porogaramu headers (Guhuza IKIRANGA ya mbere). Map table ids below.

source: Units, photo save toggles, debug Fill, and experiment screens live here.
text: Units, ifoto bika toggles, debug Kuzuza, na experiment screens live here.

source: Spreadsheet and photo destinations are under Menu → Syncing (not only this page).
text: Urupapuro rw'imibare na ifoto aho hageze ni munsi Menu → Birimo guhuza (ntabwo gusa iki urupapuro).

source: Show experiment screens reveals Alignment, Pump Experiment, and Import Old Pictures in the drawer.
text: Erekana experiment screens reveals Alignment, Pompe Experiment, na Kuzana Bushaje Amashusho muri drawer.

source: Photos permission denied. Grant Photos access in App info → Permissions so fuel photos can save to gallery.
text: Amafoto uruhushya byanzwe. Grant Amafoto kwinjira muri Porogaramu info → Permissions bityo lisansi amafoto ashobora bika kuri galeri.

source: Sync & backup lives under Menu → Syncing (spreadsheet + photo destinations, Sync now, failures).
text: Guhuza & ububiko lives munsi Menu → Birimo guhuza (urupapuro rw'imibare + ifoto aho hageze, Guhuza ubu, kunanirwa).
Nta murandasi: packaged samples → Unassigned lisansi.

source: Live: Gmail label (OAuth) and/or generic IMAP folder (host + app password).
text: Live: Gmail label (OAuth) na/cyangwa generic IMAP dosiye (host + porogaramu ijambobanga).

source: Same label/folder may hold multiple vendors; parser auto-detects.
text: Kimwe label/dosiye may hold multiple vendors; parser byikora-detects.

source: Rows: vehicle Unassigned (id 0), odometer 0, Partial Fill off.
text: Imirongo: imodoka Unassigned (ikiranga 0), odometer 0, Partial Kuzuza off.

source: IMAP uses TLS (port 993). Passwords are not written to logcat.
text: IMAP uses TLS (port 993). Passwords ni ntabwo written kuri logcat.

source: First-run walkthroughs for adding a vehicle or connecting sync (also under Help).
text: Ya mbere-koresha walkthroughs kuri adding imodoka cyangwa connecting guhuza (kandi munsi Ubufasha).

source: Label Y-band uses smallest value-cluster rect height × extra fraction (resolution-independent).
text: Label Y-band uses smallest agaciro-cluster rect height × inyongera fraction (resolution-independent).

source: Ratio lo/hi are band-gated extreme checks (not a target $/gal).
text: Ratio lo/hi ni band-gated extreme checks (ntabwo target $/gal).

source: Label Y-band extra (fraction of smallest value rect height, 0–1)
text: Label Y-band inyongera (fraction ya smallest agaciro rect height, 0–1)

source: This captures images and OCR details during a fill that can be emailed for debugging.
text: Iki captures images na OCR ibisobanuro during kuzuza icyo ashobora ba emailed kuri debugging.

source: No email app found to send report
text: Nta imeri porogaramu byabonetse kuri oherereza raporo

source: Convert existing fuel volumes between G and L?
text: Convert existing lisansi volumes between G na L?

source: If you choose No, historical numbers keep their current values but
text: Niba wowe hitamo Oya, historical numbers bika yabo current values but

source: display labels will change without conversion.
text: erekana labels azakora hindura nta conversion.

source: Deletes all Fill debug sessions and crash reports.
text: Deletes byose Kuzuza debug sessions na crash raporo.

source: Sign-in failed — try again or pick a Google account with Sheets access
text: Injira-muri byanze — gerageza nanone cyangwa hitamo Google konti na Impapuro kwinjira

source: One sign-in covers Sheets and browsing spreadsheets you own or that are shared with you.
